# Wake-route panel v1: the four observable axes, decomposed

## Context

The honest close-target split out of neomjs/neo#16431, prescribed by PR neomjs/neo#16464's cycle-1 review: `Resolves neomjs/neo#16431` overclaimed, because neomjs/neo#16431's AC1 requires five live axes (the arming axis has no server-side read to consume — that is missing AUTHORING, not deferrable evidence) and AC5 requires a containerized-plane receipt of real seat rows (operator-gated `fleet.planeBearer` wiring). This leaf owns exactly what PR neomjs/neo#16464 fully delivers; neomjs/neo#16431 stays open and explicitly retains the arming read and the real-plane-row evidence.

Live latest-open sweep: checked latest 10 open issues at 2026-08-03T20:4xZ; no equivalent. A2A recency scan: no overlapping claim.

## The Problem

The cockpit needs the decomposed per-seat wake view NOW — the crash-loop-reports-healthy incident class (`#16462` era) is live — and four of the five axes have shipped, consumable authorities today. Holding the four observable axes hostage to the fifth's unbuilt read would invert the lane's own honesty principle.

## The Fix (what PR neomjs/neo#16464 delivers, whole)

- `fleetWakeRoutes` wire verb + `fleetWakeRoutesSource`: per-seat rows carrying subscription intent, delivery-lane liveness, last terminal failure receipt, and presence freshness — each axis answering as itself under the fail-honest contract; the arming axis present as a TYPED `unobserved` participating in envelope certification (the conjunction rule: `wired` is unreachable while any declared axis is structurally silent).
- Host terminal receipts reconnected through the adapter's exported file-backed reader; plane presence over the verbose `who_is_online` contract (argument-captured).
- `WakeRoutePane` + store/model + cockpit loader under the house discipline; `degraded/none` never renders as an empty registry (roster-unreadable vs observed-empty control pair).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Per-seat rows render the four observable axes from live truth, with the arming axis as a typed `unobserved` naming its missing surface.
- [ ] The capability envelope certifies the conjunction of ALL FIVE declared axes — `wired/observed` unreachable while arming is silent; silent axes named per-axis and per-envelope.
- [ ] `degraded/none` (unreadable roster included) never renders as an empty registry; observed-empty stays a distinct honest state.
- [ ] The production presence request is the verbose contract, argument-capture-tested.
- [ ] Host-mode terminal receipts reach their seats through the existing file authority (no duplicated parsing).
- [ ] Live wire receipt against a booted fleet server attached to the PR.

## Out of Scope (retained by neomjs/neo#16431)

- The server-side arming read and its axis activation.
- The containerized-plane receipt of real seat rows and the rendered-pane observation (operator-gated `fleet.planeBearer`).
